# Type assertion in a select statement's CommClause.
typeassert {
	var i I
	i.M() == 1 -> i.(m1)
}
-- x.go --
package p

type I interface {
	M() int
}
type m1 int

func (m1) M() int { return 1 }

func _(x I, ch chan int) {
	select {
	case <-ch:
		if x.M() != 1 {
			return
		}
		_ = x
	}
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -13,6 +13,7 @@
 		if x.M() != 1 {
 			return
 		}
+		x := x.(m1)
 		_ = x
 	}
 }
